text: Her thyroid and adrenal function are normal, so I need to determine if the hyponatremia is due to SIADH or another cause. Given her smoking history and lack of volume depletion signs, I suspect a lung malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

text: The normal chest X-ray does not rule out small cell lung cancer, so I need a more sensitive imaging study. REQUEST TEST: CT_Chest.

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal imaging and thyroid/adrenal function, the severe hyponatremia is likely due to SIADH, possibly induced by her antihypertensive medications or idiopathic in origin. DIAGNOSIS READY: Syndrome of Inappropriate Antidiuretic Hormone Secretion (SIADH)
